mechanism: Celecoxib may increase methylphenidate levels through CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while methylphenidate can elevate blood pressure which may be exacerbated by celecoxib's cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; consider alternative NSAID or analgesic if cardiovascular instability occurs; counsel on fluid retention and hypertension symptoms.
